title: Single-Instance Lock (flock) Wrapper
description: Ensures only one copy of a script runs at a time using flock -- the standard fix for cron jobs or health checks that can overlap and step on each other if one run takes longer than the schedule interval.

variables.name: COMMAND_DESCRIPTION
variables.prompt: One-line description of the work being guarded (for log messages)

variables.name: COMMAND_TO_RUN
variables.prompt: The exact command (or script) to run while holding the lock

toggle_groups.name: LOCK_MODE
toggle_groups.prompt: If another instance is already running

options.label: wait for it to finish, then run anyway
